component.name: Wuwa Tappo (unofficial Qt shell)
component.summary: Native Linux shell for the Wuwa Tappo desktop pet

description.p: Unofficial, experimental. Runs the frontend of the official Windows app (which you must supply from your own installer) in QtWebEngine, with a transparent always-on-top click-through overlay, tray icon, global input counting and the multiplayer socket implemented natively. Not affiliated with Kuro Games.
